name: 89 North Music Venue

evidence.note: Venue's own Country Night listing: DJ, live bands and line dance instruction, dancing 7:30-10:30 PM, no experience needed.
Reviewer compares it to a classic rock club with tables around the stage and room for dancing.
A Yelp reviewer says there is plenty of room to hang out or dance.
A January 2026 review says they have done both standing-room and seated shows and there is room for dancing.

dancing.notes: There is open floor in front of the stage where people dance at band shows. On Wednesday country nights an instructor teaches line dances and beginners are welcome.

description: A live music club in downtown Patchogue with a stage, a big bar, table seating and standing room. It books tribute and rock bands on weekends and runs a weekly country night.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Oct 3 is a metal tribute night (Slayer and Metallica tributes), so expect a standing rock crowd, not social dancing. A review summary says the venue discourages moshing.

Directory research 2026-10-04: No usable venue photos: the site's photos are either a text-heavy private-events flyer, very short banner strips (about 1068x210, 3 photos side by side) or a blurry phone photo, so we skipped them. Facebook page photos need a login. The site does not publish regular opening hours (open on show nights); a Bing map listing shows Wed-Thu 6 PM-12 AM and Fri-Sat 7 PM-2 AM, which we did not record. Bands apply at https://89northmusic.com/band-booking-contact/ (booking@89northmusicvenue.com) and private events (events@89northmusicvenue.com). The X link is from the site footer; x.com blocks automated checks, so it was not opened. Current description still fits.

logo.alt: 89 North logo: a red star with the number 89 next to the words North, Live Music & Events, on black

evidence.note: Venue's contact page gives 89 North Ocean Avenue, Patchogue, NY 11772, the phone 631-730-8992 and a general inquiries email (info@); booking and private events have their own addresses.
Home page footer links to the venue's Facebook, Instagram, X (Twitter) and YouTube pages and lists upcoming shows, including a weekly country Wednesday.
About page describes a live music club steps from Main Street and a short walk from the Patchogue LIRR station, with a full stage, sound and lights.
Private events flyer lists a 400-person capacity and two large bars.
